sn48.64:1.4: The close _-ti_ here indicates that, following the pattern of the previous three discourses, the Sutta ends here. This is in fact the reading in BJT. The PTS, followed by Bodhi, omits this closeing statement and continues as if it were the same Sutta. In fact the next passage should belong to a separate sutta, but we follow the MS edition. BB omits this close statement in his translation, thus giving the impression that the sutta continues. In this he evidently follows the Sinhala reading via the PTS. However the Burmese readings are more coherent.
